skill_drafts.name: Maven Project Setup and Configuration
skill_drafts.description: Establish a Maven project structure, configure the POM file, and apply build profiles. Use this when initializing a new Maven project or reconfiguring an existing one.
skill_drafts.objective: Set up and configure a Maven project with correct POM and profile settings
contraindications: Debugging plugin execution during active builds
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Create or verify Maven project directory structure', 'details': 'Ensure src/main/java, src/test/java, src/main/resources, and src/test/resources directories exist; place pom.xml at project root'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Define POM project coordinates and metadata', 'details': 'Set groupId, artifactId, version, name, description, and packaging type in the POM'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Configure dependencies in POM', 'details': 'Add required dependencies with scope (compile, test, provided, runtime) and version specifications'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Set up build profiles', 'details': 'Define profiles for different build scenarios (e.g., dev, test, prod) with activation conditions and profile-specific configurations'}
{'step': 5, 'action': 'Configure plugins in POM', 'details': 'Add and configure plugins for compilation, testing, packaging, and other build phases'}
{'step': 6, 'action': 'Review Settings descriptor', 'details': 'Verify repository URLs, credentials, and local repository path in settings.xml'}
{'step': 7, 'action': 'Validate POM and settings', 'details': 'Check XML syntax and structure; run mvn validate to confirm POM correctness'}
triggers: Migrating an existing project to Maven
Reconfiguring project structure and build profiles
constraints: POM file must be valid XML
Project coordinates (groupId, artifactId, version) must be defined
Directory structure must follow Maven conventions
cautions: Ensure all dependencies are available in configured repositories before proceeding to build
Validate profile activation conditions to avoid unintended build variations
Review plugin versions for compatibility with the target Java version
output_contract: Valid POM file with correct project descriptor, profiles, and plugin configurations ready for build execution. The project structure conforms to Maven conventions, all dependencies are declared, and the POM passes validation.

metadata.prompt:
Follow these steps to set up and configure a Maven project:
1. Create or verify the project directory structure with src/main/java, src/test/java, and pom.xml at the root.
2. Define the POM file with project coordinates (groupId, artifactId, version), packaging type, and dependencies.
3. Configure build profiles in the POM to support different build scenarios (e.g., development, testing, production).
4. Set up plugin configurations in the POM for compilation, testing, and packaging.
5. Review the Settings descriptor to ensure repository and credential configurations are correct.
6. Validate the POM syntax and structure before proceeding to build execution.

skill_drafts.name: Maven Build Lifecycle Execution
skill_drafts.description: Execute Maven build phases and manage phase transitions in correct sequence. Use this skill when running builds, understanding build lifecycle flow, or coordinating phase execution.
skill_drafts.objective: Execute Maven build lifecycle phases in correct sequence and produce expected build artifacts
applicable_signals: Maven project ready for compilation or packaging
Artifact production expected at specific lifecycle stage
contraindications: Do not use when developing custom Maven plugins
Do not use for repository access configuration
Do not use for Maven settings or profile management
workflow_steps: Verify Maven project structure and POM validity
Execute Maven build command with appropriate phase
triggers: Caller needs to run a Maven build
Build phase order must be managed or verified
Build lifecycle flow understanding is required
constraints: Maven project structure must be valid
POM file must be present and well-formed
Build phases must be executed in documented lifecycle order
cautions: Phase execution order is strict; skipping phases may produce incomplete artifacts
Ensure dependencies are resolved before execution phases
output_contract: Build completes through intended lifecycle phases with expected artifacts produced and available for downstream use

metadata.prompt: Invoke this skill when you need to execute Maven build phases in the correct order. The skill guides phase sequencing and ensures build artifacts are produced as expected. Do not use this for plugin development, repository configuration, or Maven settings management.
